lines: A man collapsed due to a sharp strike from Una.
She often served as a scout on missions, but it seemed she was outstanding on the combat side of things, too.
She hopped around the narrow back alley as she took down the dwellers of the underworld one after another.
「You asshole!! Quit struggling and just diiieee!!」

「That's asking the impossible.
―――Paper Spirit: Defensive Formation!」
A gigantic axe that had been swung down at Una was repelled by a paper barrier.
That was a shield that Mai had created with her Paper Spirit powers, which protected her comrades from attacks.
「Kyaaahh?!! Thanks, Mai-chan!! You're superb! I love yoooouuuu!!」
「Ahem. Still, there are a few too many enemies. I can't defend us for long.」
「Yes!! I'll break the enemy encirclement now――Eih!!」
Mari's fist drove into the ground.
And at the same time, a huge amount of upheaved earth and sediment attacked the orcs from overhead.
「Way to go!! Everyone, let's get out through there!!!」
A gaping hole formed in the encirclement thanks to her attack.
Whether it was because of the bounty or what, the number of enemies was only growing.
At this point, we had no choice but to run away.
「Heh?!! Whoa, whoa, don't leave me behiiiind～～?!!」
「Umm, the alley on the right should be a dead end, so――this way!」
We called out to each other as we ran through the back streets.
Even though the transmitter was destroyed, we could barely shake off our pursuers.
「But――are you all okay if I keep commanding you?」
I called out to the three of them, while remaining alert about our rear.
In the heat of the moment, I had automatically given them orders in the usual way.
The three people here were not Hebiko and Shikanosuke, whom I had known for a long time.
“They might feel uneasy about taking orders from me, the underachiever.”――I wanted to check that, just in case.
「What do you mean, okay? I thought we decided at the start to leave leadership of this team to Fuuma-san, who has experience commanding.」
「W-Well, that's true, but...... I was wondering if you all felt uneasy about it.」
「Particularly with Una. It's practically your first time meeting me, right?」
She was ridiculously sociable, so we clicked right away, but actually, this mission was just about my first time talking with her.
「Fu fu fu. Fuuma-kun, do you think I would get anxious over that little?」
「All I'm afraid of is explosions and peeing!! I trust you, Fuuma-kun!!!」
「I concur. I know about Fuuma-san's skill from previous missions.」
「Of course I have confidence in you.」
Mai looked at me and smiled softly.
「Um, as for me...... Well. I'm happy to be learning so much!」
Mari looked up at me and made a big nod.
「Yes!! I get to see from right up close, “Oh, this is how Fuuma-san does it!”」
「I've been thinking I'd like to be a commander someday too!」
If it helped with her training, then I supposed the activities of this “improvised team” must at least have some meaning.
「Still, I didn't know that. Mari was an aspiring commander, huh?」
「Y-Yes! Well, rather than “aspiring”, it's more like, um......」
「Someone I admire is a really great commander, so......」
「I was thinking, “If I could be like that person too someday......” Eheheh.」
「Uheh heh. Did you see that, Mai-chan? Mari-chan, with a bright-red face. So innocent!」
「Hey. Don't interrupt them. We're right at a good part.」

「Waaaaaahhh!!! I-It's not a “good part” or
anythiiinnng～～～!!」
Having noticed the other two looking at her and grinning for some reason, Mari rushed over there, making her face bright red.
Una and Mai, on the other hand, ran away, making playful-sounding cries.
While tilting my head, left all on my own, I chased after them.
The roars of monsters resounded from the opposite end of the alley.
The number of underworld dwellers after us kept increasing, and we had been corralled into a dead-end alley before we knew it.
At this rate, it was a matter of time before those guys caught up with us.
「What do we do, Fuuma-san?! Do we fight?」
「Yeah. We have no other choice but to, huh......?」
Even if we fought here as a last resort, it would probably only increase the number of enemies.
That said, there was no other way ou――
I looked up due to an unexpected voice.
A small door at the back of the alley――That was slightly open, as if to beckon us.
「What are you doing?!!! Hurry it up!!!」
「Huooooohh?!! They're almost here!! I can hear troll footsteps right around the corner!!!」
There was no time for hesitating.
We rushed through the little door that had opened at the back of the alley.
